failures.criterion: Required CI green at the head (the `test` job of pr-and-main.yaml and the Daemon Go suite on Postgres 16); acceptance 3.3's drain test
failures.evidence: TestABacklogOfOtherPullRequestsDrainsAndAppliesEveryLegionEvent (packages/daemon/internal/intake/drain_test.go:229-231) compares `processedGitHubEvents`, read with `select source || ':' || event_id from processed_events order by 1` (drain_test.go:386), against a list sorted with Go's byte order (slices.Sort, drain_test.go:228). The SQL order follows the database's collation, so on any database whose collation ignores punctuation the two orders differ (`legion-33-checks` sorts before `legion-3-checks`) and the test fails although the set is exactly right. Red at 55eb11c8 in the required `test` job (https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/actions/runs/40762777994/job/123078824809, drain_test.go:230 `processed events = [... legion-28-checks legion-33-checks legion-38-checks legion-3-checks ...], want exactly the 50 Legion events [... legion-28-checks legion-3-checks legion-33-checks ...]`) and in `Daemon Go suite on production's Postgres 16` (job 123078824276, same line). Reproduced in the pod: with template1 recreated `locale_provider icu icu_locale 'en-US-u-ka-shifted'` on an embedded Postgres 16.4, `cd packages/daemon && LEGION_TEST_PG_DSN=<that server> LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL=<idle nats-server 2.10.22> go test -count=1 ./internal/intake/ -run BacklogOfOtherPullRequests -v` fails at drain_test.go:230 with the same ordering; on the same server with template1 under the C collation it passes (drained 16.902 s, 17.170 s, 17.382 s with LEGION_TEST_DRAIN_MEASURE=1). The existing test is the red test: make the comparison independent of the collation (sort `got` in Go, or `order by 1 collate "C"`). No product code is wrong here; the head cannot merge while the required `test` job is red.
